thread:
sam (AP): Flagging possible duplicate: Vendor-CloudX sent INV-799222 for $14,200 referencing PO-2026-401 but we already paid INV-799220 for the same period. System shows potential duplicate. Need routing.
approvals-bot: Invoice 799222 added to queue. Auto-match: PO present but potential duplicate of INV-799220 detected by fuzzy match on line items and amounts.
vendor-cloudx: Hi Sam, our apologies. We ran a billing batch twice by mistake. INV-799222 should be voided; INV-799220 is correct. We can issue a zeroing credit or void INV-799222. How would Redwood like us to proceed?
sam (AP): Please provide written void/credit confirmation. We won't pay if duplicate. GL note: awaiting vendor attestation.
drew (Engineering): For context, the two invoices are for the same reserved instance commitment period. No additional usage in the later invoice. Looks duplicate from infra side.
mira (Procurement): If vendor provides a written void/credit we can accept and AP can mark INV-799222 as void. But policy says any vendor credit that changes payment state requires PO reconciliation and an exception if the invoice was already closed. Was INV-799220 paid?
sam (AP): INV-799220 shows paid on 2026-09-02 in the ledger. So INV-799222 would require a credit note to zero it out. Vendor attestation + audit trail required; if credit > $10k, director approval needed.
vendor-cloudx: Confirming in writing: "Vendor-CloudX confirms INV-799222 is a duplicate of INV-799220. Invoice 799222 should be voided and a credit note CN-204 will be issued for $14,200. No tax impact." Attaching CN-204 when ready.
mira (Procurement): I'll create procurement exception EXC-13077: "duplicate invoice void/credit after payment" and route to Elaine for director sign-off. Attach vendor attestation and paid invoice copy.
approvals-bot: Exception EXC-13077 created: awaiting Elaine (Finance Dir) approval.
elaine (Finance Dir): Reviewed vendor attestation and payment evidence. Approving EXC-13077 to accept CN-204 and void INV-799222. AP, post the credit against the paid invoice and record a reversing entry to clear the duplicate payment. Please include reconciliation entry and vendor credit in the audit folder.
sam (AP): Applying vendor credit CN-204 to ledger. Posting reversing entry and tagging PO-2026-401. Reconciliation uploaded to EXC-13077.
vendor-cloudx: CN-204 uploaded and marked void for INV-799222. Thanks for quick handling, Redwood.
mira (Procurement): Closing EXC-13077 once vendor file confirmed in the portal. Note: I'll follow up with vendor to ensure billing system has dedupe safeguards.
drew (Engineering): Thanks team. We'll check our billing contact to confirm dedupe prevention on their side.
sam (AP): All done. Invoice INV-799222 marked void, ledger updated, PO reconciliation complete. Closing thread. :white_check_mark:
